subject: Spec review done: FAIL, 12 blocking findings
body: I ran /sc:spec-panel-armb in critique mode (requirements, architecture) on the worker-contract spec without editing it, and wrote the panel result, a 36-row boundary table and 16 numbered findings to review/spec-panel.md; verdict FAIL. The Orca-on-top decision holds, but the return contract conflicts with existing producers (they write status success, not succeeded, so the 7.2 step-4 check rejects them), its path is not one rule (workflow refuses --output and generates its folder name), retries reuse the same output folder, P1 adds --unattended to commands whose prompts are still live, live checks never install the edited files, and three acceptance checks cannot fail as written (bullet deletions slip past the additive grep; table-escaped pipes make AC-C1 match nothing). Left for Task 6: fix blocking findings 1-12 listed in the Reviser brief; findings 13-16 are notes only.
